exact_rules.box12_breakout_retest: Standalone candidate: box is high/low of exactly the 12 bars preceding a breakout bar; box height / box midpoint <=2%. A completed close beyond the box must occur 1-3 bars before signal; intervening closes stay beyond its boundary. Retest bar touches within 0.1% of boundary and closes beyond it; signal at that retest close. First matching most-recent breakout only.
exact_rules.dashboard_breakout: Existing intraday_eval.breakout_signal; 3 rising oriented impulse candles, one opposing handle, then close beyond handle; 5-50% retracement, handle low above impulse origin, handle high <=0.2% above impulse peak, confirmation quote-volume / handle quote-volume >=1.0.
exact_rules.ema20_50_cross: Standalone crossover: EMA20 crosses above EMA50 for long / below for short at signal close. Each EMA is seeded with its first-period SMA; alpha=2/(period+1).
exact_rules.momentum_1h_ema20_context: Three-close momentum, separately filtered: latest fully completed, UTC-aligned 1h aggregate close is above its EMA20 for long / below for short.
exact_rules.momentum_4h_ema20_context: Three-close momentum, separately filtered: latest fully completed, UTC-aligned 4h aggregate close is above its EMA20 for long / below for short.
exact_rules.momentum_rvol_1_5: Three-close momentum, separately filtered: signal-bar quote_volume divided by the arithmetic mean of the prior 20 bars' quote_volume >=1.5.
exact_rules.three_close_momentum: Existing intraday_eval.momentum_signal; three strictly rising (long) or falling (short) closes; one signal at each qualifying close.
exact_rules.utc_session_vwap_reclaim: Standalone UTC-day VWAP reclaim: HLC3 weighted by base_volume from 00:00 UTC; signal when close crosses from below to above VWAP (long) or above to below (short), using current completed bar and prior same-day bar.

omissions_and_scope: No actual trade-level volume, order-book profile/POC/value area, RSI, Bollinger, daily levels, or walk-forward analysis.
OHLCV VWAP proxy and fixed box definition are hypotheses, not validated strategy specifications.
Only the saved 45-day, 12-symbol Bitget snapshots are used; no broader data and no Binance API.
No guarantee or financial recommendation; scenarios are not measured execution results.

higher_timeframes.1h: complete UTC bins only, EMA20; reset after missing bin; 20-bin warmup
higher_timeframes.4h: complete UTC bins only, EMA20; reset after missing bin; 20-bin warmup

parameters.outcome: one next candle only; MFE/MAE from entry open to that candle high/low

round_trip_cost_scenarios_bps.12: Two 6 bps taker fees; historical fee constancy unverified.
round_trip_cost_scenarios_bps.22: 12 bps assumed fees + 10 bps assumed spread/slippage.
round_trip_cost_scenarios_bps.37: 12 bps assumed fees + 25 bps assumed spread/slippage.

parameters.vwap: UTC calendar day; cumulative HLC3 * base_volume / cumulative base_volume; complete cadence from midnight required; no cross-midnight

protocol: Rules are fixed for this exploratory follow-up. Variants are separate one-at-a-time arms, not cumulatively optimized. Signals are event-level and can overlap; no portfolio sizing, funding, liquidation, execution, spread, queue, or market impact model. OOS timestamps were already inspected by the parent study; this is exploratory reuse, not untouched validation.
source: Saved Bitget USDT-FUTURES historical-candles snapshot; no network/API fetch.
